meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计低噪声量子电路,并在谷歌量子处理器上运行实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在量子计算领域做研发,需要设计面向谷歌量子芯片的自定义电路。
copy.tagline_en: Build noise-resilient quantum circuits and run experiments on Google quantum hardware.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're researching quantum and need to run custom circuits on Google chips.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Cirq 在 Python 里搭建、模拟和优化量子电路,产出可运行的电路代码与测量结果,并支持参数扫描、噪声建模、编译到硬件门集以及提交到量子后端。
howto.when: 当你提到 Cirq、构建或模拟量子电路,或要为 Google 量子硬件做噪声感知设计时触发。IBM 硬件、量子机器学习、物理模拟场景应改用 qiskit、pennylane、qutip。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds, simulates, and optimizes quantum circuits in Python with Cirq, producing runnable circuit code and measurement results, plus parameter sweeps, noise modeling, compilation to hardware gatesets, and job submission to backends.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Cirq, circuit building/simulation, or noise-aware design for Google quantum hardware. For IBM hardware, quantum ML, or physics simulation, use qiskit, pennylane, or qutip.
